known_gaps: Byte-scan proof is strict: short removed strings (< 6 bytes, e.g. kerned word pieces, subset glyph codes) are excluded from the scan (RedactedOutput.short_needles) because they legitimately occur elsewhere; for natural-language documents a distinctive removed word that also appears elsewhere (kept text) yields hits and is_proven() == false. The structural proof is residual_in_region == 0 on a fresh pass over the saved bytes (same region test, so not independent of the interpreter).

Whole strings are removed (a string straddling the region edge is removed entirely); standard fonts without /Widths use an upper-bound advance, and layout_shift_possible is reported when following text on the line may move.
Rotated pages: region is in default user space (no /Rotate or /CropBox mapping). Encrypted PDFs are structure-only (no decryption).

Same-parser reopen is not independent evidence; the tests use raw byte comparison and an independent miniz_oxide inflate scan of every stream body as the oracle. Acrobat-saved fixture oracle still pending (Acrobat DC installed, foreground session needs Operator approval per START_LOG D5).

Text inside Type3 glyph procs and tiling patterns, outlines and structure ActualText are not edited by redaction; the payload proof flags the removed strings if they survive there (sanitize drops Thumb/PieceInfo/XMP on request).
is_proven is strict by design: a distinctive removed word that also lives in metadata or outlines is a hit; region_cleared gives the per-instance answer.
decisions: Object numbers are preserved on full save (no renumbering) so unmodified objects can be copied byte-verbatim; free numbers get a linked free list.
Redaction rewrites the page content into a NEW object and repoints /Contents instead of editing shared streams in place.
Fail closed on unsupported painted content by default; ReportAndContinue is an explicit caller choice.
Signed documents are refused for every mutation including full save (a full rewrite invalidates byte-range signatures); incremental policy is later scope.
